dedupe_keys.name: temoaproject exploring state level energy and climate policy options a north carolina case study

description: The TemoaProject archive preserves code and data used in Li and colleagues’ 2018 study of state-level energy and climate policy options in North Carolina. The description explicitly identifies the study-specific bundle and the Temoa open-source energy-system model. Zenodo lists one ZIP archive and provides free open access under the deposited GPL 2.0 licence. Coverage is North Carolina, United States, with scenario years, temporal aggregation, technology lists and input vintages not stated in the native description. The related Temoa record describes the general model; the separate North Carolina energy-storage resource corresponds to another named study. Shared underlying state inputs may occur, and experimental or data independence is not asserted. The sparse metadata does not establish execution requirements beyond the model relationship. No archive or code body was read and numerical policy conclusions were not inferred.
